item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is making a lampshade at home in Jaipur. She wants a material that lets only some light pass through it, so the lamp gives a soft glow and objects cannot be seen clearly through it.
She tests four materials by shining a torch on each. Which material is translucent?

options.A: a clear glass plate that lets almost all the torch light pass through
options.B: a sheet of butter paper that lets some light pass but objects look blurry through it
options.C: a wooden board that blocks all the torch light completely
options.D: a thin mirror that reflects all the torch light back
